intro: I design and build products, from the client’s needs to production.
intro_detail: Client relationships, software, infrastructure, pipelines: I take ownership of the whole process.
projects_intro: A selection of what I build and what I explore.
spellwar_summary: A 3D game and its engine, built with C++ and OpenGL.
spellwar_detail: SpellWar is a third-person game set on floating platforms. The repository brings together a custom engine and game logic, exploring rendering, animation, input and camera systems.
spellwar_focus: Build a game’s foundations and put them to work in a playable world.
plants_detail: An exploration of formal grammars and generative algorithms to represent plant growth. This is an experimental project; its structure and features are still evolving.
plants_focus: Turn simple rules into complex visual structures.
eyefox_summary: An Android puzzle: two grids, one rule, many combinations.
eyefox_detail: The idea: make two grids identical. Flipping the colour of a tile also flips its neighbours. A Java project for Android, from puzzle logic to a mobile interface.
eyefox_focus: Turn a simple mechanic into a complete game experience.
skull_summary: A TypeScript foundation for building web applications.
skull_detail: An application foundation combining a React and TanStack frontend, a NestJS API, typed contracts, authentication and CI checks. The frontend uses Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Zod, Paraglide and Sonner.
skull_focus: Set explicit conventions for growing a product: boundaries, shared components, validation and documentation.
about_title:

about_intro: I’m Mathis Dubuisson, an engineering graduate from ENSICAEN. I work in Product & Software Engineering.
about_body: My work connects client needs with technical decisions. I take a product from end to end: talking to users, developing software, setting up infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
about_outro: My personal projects are also a place to explore games, computer graphics and generative systems.
approach_1_body: Talk with the client and clarify the problem the product needs to solve.
approach_2_body: Design the software and make the technical decisions it requires.
approach_3_body: Set up the infrastructure, pipelines and deployment.
